comparison.objective: Lay three floorboards tightly together while maintaining 10–20 mm wall gaps; candidate tunes an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests long-board placement, edge mating, and gap control; candidate tests fine tool alignment, collar rotation, counterholding, locking torque, and iterative dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires tight board joints and specified wall gaps; candidate requires compliant repeated stops with no hard-stop strike, excess rebound, overload, or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Static multi-part layout and gap control are different from adjustable damping commissioning. No spec versions or tight-joint tolerance/damage rubric are available.
